verdict.rationale: New Relic documents vendor-maintained infrastructure monitoring for hosts, containers, providers, and networks (new-relic-docs-31). It also covers cloud services through AWS Lambda monitoring using CloudWatch data plus code-level agent instrumentation (new-relic-docs-18), and fleet-scale agent management via Agent Control with Terraform (new-relic-docs-42). Kubernetes collection is only implied: by Kubernetes spend visibility and by a user report that in-cluster collection services exist but are fragile. missing for 10: explicit first-party Kubernetes integration docs, breadth of cloud-provider integrations beyond Lambda, independent corroboration that in-cluster collection is reliable.
